description: This file is a script for running Vitest tests with custom lock handling, cleanup, and argument parsing. It manages a lock, prepares test specifications, runs tests via spawn, and handles process termination and cleanup.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures the lock is released only once, calling acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync's release function.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes the includeFilePath associated with a spec, if it exists, handling errors silently.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a single Vitest specification by spawning a process, handling cleanup on exit or error, and resolving with the result.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates the default test specification object for a root Vitest run based on parsed args.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that determines what tests to run, manages lock, and handles process exit based on test results.
